name: Valence Caravan
description: Steer a growing bonded body through procedural reaction chambers.
natural_language: Steer A to join every atom into one body and fill every bond slot. Bonded atoms move together. Turn only with A on a ring. Undo and reset are available.

metadata.notes: Original generated chambers; automatic single bonds on adjacency, rigid connected-component movement, grid turntables, and valence/connectivity replay. All geometry is visible; no hidden target graph.
